pkgmetadata.longdescription: On GNOME (mutter 50 and newer) every X11 window is drawn at the next whole scale factor, so on a desktop scaled to 125-175 % a game's window appears at half or less of the size the desktop uses. horcrux-game-scale runs the game in a nested gamescope that mutter sizes to the monitor; horcrux-steam-launch-options puts it in front of every Steam game's launch options. Monitor size, refresh rate and scale come from mutter at launch; settings in /etc/horcrux/game-scale.toml.
